description: Shared corpus for sample-data packs (spec 3.5, 11 and 12.1 sample-data-resolution). Both the C# engine (Engine.Specs/for_SampleData) and the TypeScript engine (engine/for_sampleData) assert every case independently: generated rows must be byte-identical once serialized, so a change to the generator algorithm (documented in SampleRandom.ts and Documentation/blueprints/sample-data.md) fails both. Expected values are produced by the reference algorithm; do not edit them by hand.
